description: This file contains functions for managing and fixing state events within the BORIS behavioral observation software, including checking for unpaired events and fixing them, with GUI interactions.

classes.name: Ask_time
classes.description: Dialog class for asking user to specify a time

methods.name: check_state_events
methods.description: Checks state events for each subject or current observation, displaying results in a dialog.

methods.name: fix_unpaired_events
methods.description: Fixes unpaired state events, either automatically or by user input, updating the observations accordingly.
